messages.task:
You are a financial-analytics assistant.  Use the available tools to research the company data, reason through the information, and provide a concise, numeric answer to the user’s question.

SCENARIO
CDW Corporation and subsidiaries issued various equity-based awards at the time of its initial public offering (IPO).  Among them were Restricted Stock Units ("RSUs") granted under the 2013 Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP).  The narrative disclosure states that the company granted 1,416,543 RSUs in connection with the IPO at a weighted-average grant-date fair value of $17.03 per unit.  The RSUs cliff-vest after four years.  The company attributes the value of equity-based compensation awards to service periods using the straight-line method and uses the Black-Scholes model for valuing stock options.

TOOLS
The following Python tool functions can be invoked.  They will return up-to-date information from the finance database needed to solve the task.  You may call any of them as necessary:
• list_equity_award_types() – return an array of all equity-award codes that exist (e.g., ["RSU", "OPT" …]).
• describe_equity_award_type(code) – given an award code, return its textual description.
• get_award_ids_by_type(code) – given an award code, return a list of internal award_id values for that type.
• get_award_overview(award_id) – return a dict with basic data for the specific award_id, including grant_name, grant_date and total_units.
• list_price_types_for_award(award_id) – list the kinds of prices stored for the award (e.g., ["grant_date_fair_value", "strike_price" …]).
• get_price_for_award(award_id, price_type) – fetch the numeric price for the given award_id and price_type.
• compute_total_deemed_proceeds(award_id, price_type="grant_date_fair_value") – convenience helper that multiplies total_units by the requested price_type for a single award.
• get_average_price_across_award_type(code, price_type="grant_date_fair_value") – return the average of a price_type across all awards of a given code.
• get_total_units_for_award_name(grant_name_substr) – sum total_units for all awards whose grant_name contains the supplied substring (case-insensitive).

You may combine tool calls with your own calculations when needed.  Return ONLY the final answer as a plain integer with no commas or explanation.

QUESTION
For the Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) granted in connection with the IPO, what would the total deemed proceeds be to the company assuming the RSUs were vested at the average price per unit?
